Re: Cape Clear

For yet another stunning version of this air, check the promotional video Brian Hughes did for McNeela Instruments’s Wild A whistle. With the different phrasing he envisioned, he was able to incorporate some progressions and ornamentation we don’t usually hear. I’m not posting this to promote any vendor or product but to offer another interpretation of the air. https://fb.watch/rDEEkb0Xpp/

↳ Posted by JimAman on April 23rd, 2024.

Re: Cape Clear
